capabilities: Capture pressed keys and key sequences
Insert captured shortcuts at the cursor position
Show captured keys in the status bar during capture
Format special keys readably (arrows, Space, Enter)
Configure the finish key in settings
disambiguation: Not a hotkey manager or remapper; it only records key presses and inserts them as text.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture and write down keyboard shortcuts as formatted text while writing notes.
summary: Hotkey capture tool that records pressed key combinations and inserts them as readable text at the cursor in a note.
